# Effort capacity model

Use these assumptions when estimating the user's team-ticket capacity, not for personal projects. Prefer any more specific recorded budget and avoid deducting the same overhead twice.

**Working capacity model** (use when estimating the user's team workload):

| Input | Weekly capacity |
| --- | --- |
| Expected delivery | 3–5 story points per engineer |
| Workweek | 40 hours |
| Daily Scrum | 5 × 15 minutes = 1.25 hours |
| Refinement | Approximately 1.5 hours |
| Sprint planning | 1 hour |
| Unplanned work (requests, assistance, incidents, bugs) | 20% = 8 hours |

**Planned-work capacity:** Approximately 28.25 hours per week (40 − 8 − 1.25 − 1.5 − 1). For a rough planning comparison, divide this capacity by 3–5 story points; this is a range, not a fixed hours-per-point conversion. Account for remaining availability and prior effort. Do not deduct meetings or the unplanned-work allowance again when a recorded budget already includes them.
